I withdrew the finding. The plan row it cites (DB ECC sets the status bit, raises the MCU error interrupt and sets `HW_ERROR_NON_FATAL` for the SOC) is covered by a different test, `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_ecc`, which checks the DB ECC interrupt and `HW_ERROR_NON_FATAL`.

`smoke_test_mcu_mbox_csrs_warm_rst` only checks the HW status double-error bit, as a precondition before triggering the warm reset. Nothing in the repo links plan row 123 to it, so the link looks inferred by the analysis.

The verdict was accepted. I added `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_ecc.c` as a new source.
